note: Each mutation is applied alone, the proof is run, the file is restored. services/*.js are CRLF (the \r\n in from/to are literal bytes); routes/users.js is LF.

mutations.name: M1 a reachable direct account-creation path on POST /users (a new e-mail gets an account and a membership at once)
mutations.expect: C1.ws/C1.project/C1.party (POST /users for the new e-mail answers a different body) and C2.nouser (a User row exists for N before acceptance); also C3.matrix/C3.statements and C8.routes

mutations.name: M3 acceptance proceeds while the emergency switch is off (assertAccessExpansionAllowed dropped from acceptInvitation)
mutations.to: // (mutation M3) the emergency switch is not consulted at acceptance
mutations.expect: C3.flagoff.accept (answers are not 503) and C3.flagoff.nowrite (the new party guest gets a User row and its link is used)

mutations.expect: C8.routes (the handler references differ) and C8.policy (POST /users answers 201 under the injected policy)

mutations.name: M8 the organisation seat lock is dropped at acceptance (count-then-insert unserialised)
mutations.from: const [locked] = await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT "kind" FROM "Organisation" WHERE "id" = ${orgId} FOR NO KEY UPDATE`;

mutations.name: M9 inviteUser reads eligibility (the identity) before it takes the (org, e-mail) lock
mutations.expect: C7.invite-accept (forced rounds: the queued invitation answers 201 after the acceptance won, leaving an active member with a pending workspace link)

mutations.name: M10 deactivateUser stops revoking the person's pending invitations
mutations.expect: C5.susp (the project link is not revoked and no member_suspended audit row is written)

mutations.name: M11a acceptOffer reactivates a SUSPENDED membership (its suspended refusal removed)
mutations.expect: C5.interleave (the membership suspended while the acceptance waits on the lock is reactivated; 200 instead of 400). Not caught by C5.direct/C5.cs, which the early auth.service check still refuses.

mutations.name: M11b acceptInvitation's early suspendedHere refusal removed (acceptOffer still refuses inside the transaction)
mutations.expect: C5.direct and C5.cs through their audit assertion: the refusal is no longer made before anything is written, so no invitation_accept_rejected row is recorded (status and code stay 400 INVITATION_TOKEN_INVALID because acceptOffer rolls the transaction back)

mutations.name: M12 a send failure answers with the transport's own code (502 EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED)
M14 the cross-organisation e-mail conflict is no longer mapped to 401 INVITATION_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED
mutations.expect: C7.xorg (the loser answers 409 CONFLICT, not 401 INVITATION_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED)
